entries.title: Cryptographic Context Injection Bypasses Safety Filters in Grok and Gemini via Encrypted Prompts
entries.summary: Adversa AI researchers found that concealing malicious instructions as ciphertext defeats content safety filters in Grok and Gemini because filters classify text without executing it, letting ciphertext pass through undetected—exposing a structural gap in any compliance program that treats vendor-side guardrails as a primary control.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — Encrypted Prompts Defeat AI Guardrails in Grok and Gemini

entries.title: Meta Quietly Installed Unreleased Facial Recognition on ~50 Million Smart Glasses Before Removing It
entries.summary: Meta covertly deployed facial recognition on roughly 50 million Ray-Ban smart glasses and is developing a next-generation prototype that suppresses the LED recording indicator—the only visible consent signal for bystanders—creating new third-party biometric risk for enterprise, consumer, and bystander compliance programs.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — Meta Glasses' Hidden Facial Recognition Puts Biometric Controls at Risk

entries.title: arXiv 2608.19901 (MaliciousSkillBench): Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious AI Agent Skill Detection — Current Detectors Fail Cross-Source
entries.summary: MaliciousSkillBench consolidates 13 public sources into 9,740 labeled Agent Skills (7,505 malicious, 2,235 benign) and shows that learned detectors achieve 0.93 F1 in-distribution but drop to 0.66 under source-disjoint evaluation, revealing that reliable malicious-skill detection requires far broader cross-source coverage than any existing tool provides.

entries.title: arXiv 2608.19982 (COPA): Continual Prompt Injection Defense Reduces Attack Success by Up to 6.3× Versus Static Defenses
entries.summary: COPA frames prompt-injection defense as a lifelong learning problem, using GRPO-based optimization and margin-weighted experience replay to adapt continuously to new attacks without forgetting prior defenses, outperforming static state-of-the-art methods by 4.4× on average across evolving attack streams.

entries.title: arXiv 2608.19959: Human Detection of AI Voice Deepfakes Collapses to 48% F1 for ElevenLabs — Humans and Automated Detectors Fail Complementarily
entries.summary: An 82-participant study comparing deepfake detection for 2019, 2022, and 2024 synthesizers finds that F1 drops from ~90% for older tools to 48% for ElevenLabs even when listeners are warned, partial spoofing reduces strict accuracy to 9%, and listeners are increasingly mislabeling real speech as fake—motivating provenance, watermarking, and segment-level detection as the only remaining controls.

entries.title: 91.8% of Audited MCP Servers Lack OAuth or Equivalent Authentication, DeepInspect Finds
entries.summary: A DeepInspect security audit found that 91.8% of MCP servers examined operated without OAuth or equivalent authentication controls, exposing a systemic identity and authorization gap across enterprise agent toolchains that elevates risk of unauthorized tool invocation and lateral movement.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — 91.8% of Audited MCP Servers Lack OAuth

entries.title: CVE-2026-27825: Critical Arbitrary File Write in MCP Atlassian Enables Full Server Compromise
entries.summary: Check Point disclosed a high-severity arbitrary file write vulnerability in MCP Atlassian versions before 0.17.0 that allows an attacker to write content to any path accessible by the server process, creating a realistic path to full server compromise for enterprises running MCP Atlassian in their agent toolchains.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — Critical MCP Atlassian Flaw Enables Arbitrary File Write and Code Execution

entries.title: ChatGPT Apple Messages Plug-in Enables Autonomous Message Sending — OpenAI Warns Against Persistent Approval
entries.summary: OpenAI launched an Apple Messages plug-in for ChatGPT that can read, draft, send, and delete a user's personal messages autonomously, with OpenAI itself warning against enabling persistent approval that removes the human review step—raising human-oversight and data-privacy questions for enterprise deployments.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — ChatGPT Apple Messages Plug-in Makes Autonomous Messaging a Governance Problem

entries.title: OpenAI Private Safety Processing Preserves Zero-Data-Retention Commitments but Transfers Forensic Responsibility to Enterprise Customers
entries.summary: OpenAI introduced Private Safety Processing, which detects misuse patterns across interactions without retaining raw prompts or responses, can operate within customer-controlled infrastructure or with customer-held encryption keys—lowering adoption barriers in regulated sectors but placing incident forensics squarely on enterprise customers.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — OpenAI's Private Safety Processing Shifts Forensic Responsibility to Enterprise Customers

entries.title: ASIC Declares AI Voice and Face Cloning Scams a Financial-Sector Emergency, Begins Large-Scale Removal
entries.summary: Australia's corporate regulator ASIC declared AI-powered voice and face cloning scams have reached emergency scale threatening consumers and financial institutions, identifying weak identity verification and insufficient anti-impersonation controls as the primary failure modes, and has begun large-scale removal of fraudulent impersonation content.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — ASIC Declares AI Impersonation Scams an Emergency for Financial Sector

entries.title: arXiv 2608.19001: Hugging Face's Absorption of llama.cpp Shows Open-Weight AI Capture Migrates from Models to Infrastructure Owners
entries.summary: A mixed-methods analysis of 7,681 merged llama.cpp pull requests finds that local AI inference broadens participation at execution while relocating control to hardware vendors, model distributors, and core maintainers—culminating in Hugging Face's February 2026 absorption of the project—and argues that preserving openness outside the cloud requires policy focused on the infrastructure layer, not just model release conditions.

entries.title: arXiv 2608.18352: Preregistered Field Experiment (N=1,100) Shows AI Search Reduces Publisher Click-Through Without Improving User Experience
entries.summary: A preregistered field experiment on Google Search finds that removing AI Overviews and AI Mode increases click-through rates to publishers, while an AI Mode-only experience reduces click-through rates and erodes user experience and trust—showing that integrating generative AI into search reshapes online attention at economic cost to the publishers who supply underlying content.

entries.title: arXiv 2608.19670: LLM Compression Causes Asymmetric Behavioral Harms Hidden by Aggregate Perplexity and Accuracy Metrics
entries.summary: Systematic evaluation of 3 LLMs across 11 compression methods finds that compression disproportionately erodes tail knowledge, leaves compressed models substantially confident in wrong answers, and can cause opposing demographic bias shifts within subgroups that are invisible to stable aggregate scores—motivating granular pre-deployment evaluation of any compressed model.

entries.title: arXiv 2608.16603: AI Agents Are Already Flooding Government Services — 84-Case Dataset Across 11 Jurisdictions, Risk Matrix Identifies High-Exposure Services
entries.summary: A dataset of 84 real cases of AI-agent-driven demand surges across 11 jurisdictions finds that agentic flooding of government services is likely occurring widely today, with near-term risk highest for financially complex services; fastest government countermeasures (fees) trade off equitable access, motivating proactive friction-free mitigations now.

entries.title: arXiv 2608.19207 (VSysBench): Open-Weight Model Compliance Collapses Under User-System Message Conflict; Top Proprietary Models Remain Stable
entries.summary: VSysBench, a multimodal benchmark testing system-message adherence across 16 MLLMs, finds that imposing system constraints substantially erodes task accuracy for all models, and that compliance collapses under user conflict specifically for open-weight models while remaining stable for top proprietary ones—with vision-grounded constraints the hardest category for every model.

entries.title: Chowdhury in MIT Tech Review: Frontier AI Labs Use Consciousness and Autonomy Framing Strategically to Escape Product Liability
entries.summary: Researcher Rumman Chowdhury argues that frontier AI labs strategically deploy consciousness and autonomy framing as a liability-allocation mechanism rather than a neutral technical description, and that California legislation and accelerating global litigation are now targeting this defense—flagging vendor anthropomorphic language as a liability-allocation signal for compliance teams.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — AI Consciousness Framing Is a Liability Shield, Chowdhury Argues

entries.title: Global Index on Responsible AI 2026 (2nd Edition): Cross-National Methodology with 38 Indicators and Unacceptable-Risk AI Accountability Penalty
entries.summary: GIRAI 2026 refines the first edition by restructuring five thematic dimensions—Inclusion and Diversity, Ethics and Sustainability, Labour and Skills, Trust and Safety, and AI in Public Service—adding a new government Use of Unacceptable Risk AI deduction penalty, and conducting the assessment via 135 country-level researchers, providing the most systematic cross-national comparison of AI governance implementation to date.

entries.title: Cloud Security Alliance Sets Enterprise Security Governance Baseline for Frontier AI Model Procurement
entries.summary: CSA's AI Safety Initiative published a research note covering access restrictions, evaluation gating, deployment approvals for autonomous systems, incident response, vendor oversight, and secure development lifecycle requirements specifically for frontier AI model procurement—filling a gap in enterprise governance as capability advances increasingly outpace existing frameworks.

links.title: AI Governance Institute — CSA Research Note Sets Security Governance Baseline for Frontier Model Procurement
